expectations.text: The paddle position values are read from SID registers $D419 (POTX) and $D41A (POTY)
CIA1 port A ($DC00) bits 6 and 7 select which control port's paddle pair is routed to the SID
Notes the keyboard matrix shares CIA1 port A, so keyboard scanning interferes with paddle selection (must disable/avoid keyscan)
expectations.evidence: 'lower bits drive keyboard-scan columns... Writing select value clobbers keyboard scan'; uses SEI to stop keyscan IRQ

expectations.text: Each port has two paddles (X and Y), giving four total across the two ports
